what: RELX sells information and analytics. LexisNexis supplies legal research and risk data, Elsevier publishes scientific journals and research tools, and it also runs exhibitions and insurance analytics.
customers: Law firms, insurers, banks, universities, researchers, hospitals and companies attending its trade shows.
money: identity, fraud and insurance analytics through LexisNexis Risk
Elsevier journals, databases and clinical tools
LexisNexis legal research and workflow tools
moat: Data assets built over decades that cannot be recreated, embedded into customers' daily workflow and renewed by subscription.
risks: Open-access publishing pressures the scientific journals model
AI tools could replace some legal research work
Most revenue is earned outside the United States, so currency moves matter
opportunities: Return on invested capital near 24% with mostly subscription revenue
It is adding AI tools to legal and scientific products at higher prices
Risk analytics grows with fraud and identity verification demand
watch: Underlying revenue growth by segment, especially Risk.
